How Publix is owned
by its workers

lines.text: Publix sells its stock only to its workers and its board.
lines.say: Publix sells its stock only to its workers and its board.

lines.text: There's no stock exchange. Publix's own board sets the price, using an outside appraisal.
lines.say: There's no stock exchange. Publix's own board sets the price, using an outside appraisal.

lines.text: Adjusted for a 2022 split, the March price went from $9.78 in 2020 to $19.65 in 2026.
lines.say: Adjusted for a twenty twenty-two split, the March price went from nine seventy-eight in twenty twenty to nineteen sixty-five in twenty twenty-six.

lines.text: After a year with 1,000+ work hours, associates can get free shares through an employee stock plan.
lines.say: After a year with a thousand-plus work hours, associates can get free shares through an employee stock plan.

lines.text: By the end of 2025, the plan's shares were worth $13.9 billion.
lines.say: By the end of twenty twenty-five, the plan's shares were worth thirteen point nine billion dollars.

lines.text: To cash out, owners generally sell back to Publix at the board's price.
lines.say: To cash out, owners generally sell back to Publix at the board's price.

lines.text: Example: 100 shares at the March 2022 price cost $1,376; four years later, $1,965 (price only).
lines.say: For example, a hundred shares at the March twenty twenty-two price cost thirteen seventy-six dollars; four years later, nineteen sixty-five, price only.

post.title: Publix sells its stock only to its workers and board
post.ig:
Publix sells its stock only to its workers and its board.

Publix stock isn't on any exchange; the board sets the price each quarter using an outside appraisal.
Split-adjusted, the March 1 price went from $9.78 in 2020 to $19.65 in 2026.
After a year with 1,000+ work hours, associates can get free shares through the ESOP. ESOP shares were worth $13.9B at Dec 27, 2025.
Example: 100 shares at the March 2022 price ($1,376) were worth $1,965 at the March 2026 price, price only.

Sources: Publix FY2025 10-K, Publix quarterly results releases (2020-2026), Publix ESOP plan page.
News and education, not financial advice.

post.yt_desc:
Publix stock isn't traded on any exchange: it's sold only to employees and board members, and the board sets the price using an outside appraisal (Publix FY2025 10-K). Split-adjusted, the March 1 price rose from $9.78 in 2020 to $19.65 in 2026, and the ESOP, which can give eligible associates free shares, held shares worth $13.9B at the end of 2025. News and education, not financial advice.
